basis: Calibrated on plan dimension chains: outer wall faces at pixels x=247/612 span 10000 mm and y=150/878 span 20000 mm (27.32 mm/px x, 27.43 mm/px y). Perimeter declared on observed outer faces; interior dividers declared on observed ink midplanes (single-line partitions at the 2px ink line; double-line partitions wall-A/wall-B2/wall-C/wall-D/wall-E at the midpoint of their two faces). Wall thickness not drawn to scale; labels read 240, assumed 240 mm nominal. All openings placed on their measured jamb pixels; exterior opening heights from the four elevations.

assumptions: Wall thickness 240 mm nominal: partitions are drawn as single ink lines or thin line pairs with '240' labels; exterior walls drawn ~10 px filled.
Interior door heights 2.1 m assumed; no interior elevation is supplied. Exterior doors use their elevation chains (sill 0.2, head 2.6).
Floor level taken as z=0; elevation chains measure from the drawn grade line, which may sit slightly below finished floor.
Roof assumed flat at eaves height 4.5 m shown on all four elevations; no roof plan supplied.

The corridor strip, east hall and SE desk area are not separated by drawn walls (wall-C stops at the corridor, wall-E return stub ends at y~752 px), so they compile as one connected open space; door D8 in wall-E still separates the SE desk area from the east hall on that side.
